page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. A blot over the first lines.

main_text.p: pellit, ut duello suscepto se purget, aut aliter causâ cadat, metu illum eo adigit; & quidem tali, qui etiam in virum constantem possit cadere. Ergo nec ea rata sunt habenda, quæ sic elicita, quæ sic probata.

Idenim certum est, perplurimos, reperiri, qui malint potius causam suam amissam, quam ut cum adversâ parte descenderent in certamen. Quid si enim qui incusavit robustus sit, & exercitatus, qui incusatur, infirmis sit viribus, & armis tractandis minus aptus. An non huic vel ipsa mors metuenda, etiam cum ignominiâ.

Neque dissentiunt hic canones, in quibus duella referuntur ad vulgares purgationes, quales dicuntur esse explorationes per ferrum candens per aquam calidam, & quæ sunt hujus generis plures inventiones.

page.notes: The first lines are partly covered by a dark ink blot over "purget" and the start of "pellit". Read as "pellit" and "purget", but the letters under the blot are uncertain. "Idenim" is printed without a space; copied as printed. The final word "inventiones" is followed by a stray mark that may be a period or a printer's dot; copied as "nes." with the line ending as printed. Faint marks at the bottom right corner are a digitiser or scan edge and are not transcribed.
